digest.component_or_area: rich-text codec cutover and echo suppression
propositions: State-based echo suppression by baseline diff (ADR-0026) must replace codec round-trip validation because DC's codec is lossy and decode(encode(x)) ≠ x cannot gate loops.
Cloud and DC send paths must post rendered output once and converge to zero updates on subsequent passes; Cloud emits ADF, DC emits rendered wiki.

Local-side normalizer in baseline compare must normalize outbound (decode∘to_wire) while emit compare stays unchanged (plain inbound-decoded remote); both compares must remain distinct to preserve lossy round-trip cancellation.
Concurrent both-sides body edits must keep rebar's value (local-wins, unchanged from a713) and emit outbound-field-conflict alert.

An inline change-gated 8-byte rich_sha (no per-pass timestamp) must track wire identity and trigger exactly one GET at threshold RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT=2 to bound loops; the GET overlays into synced_fields but never writes baseline directly.

The cutover flag (reconciler.rich_text_cutover: off|cloud|dc|both) gates both send paths and defaults OFF; with marklas extra absent, cutover degrades to plain-text ADF behavior rather than raising; with flag off, wire path is byte-identical to pre-cutover.
